interface.longDescription: 85 portable skills plus optional local tools for Playwright website QA, design verification, evidence-based skill evaluations, cross-tenant security reviews, MCP compatibility and background-job observability. Tools require separate installation and approved environments.
defaultPrompt: Use DevFlowForge to research the users and design a new accessible SaaS dashboard with wireframes, design tokens and an implementation plan.
Audit this repository across architecture, security, product UX, performance and test coverage. Select only relevant skills and cite evidence.

Implement this feature using TDD: show a failing test, make the smallest fix, rerun unit and integration checks, and confirm release gates. Offer a scoped, authorized penetration test only if appropriate.
